Dear [Madam](../persons.html#2165)
As far as I can remember the first four tales were
[Redclyffe ](../books.html#15)
[Heartsease](../books.html#19)
[Hopes and Fears](../books.html#37)
[Dynevor Terrace](../books.html#27)	
because I meant them to have some sort of analogy to the four seasons[^2]
[The Daisy Chain](../books.html#24)
[Trial](../books.html#53)
are really connected, and the [Pillars of the House](../books.html#109) came later but picked up on [Countess Kate](../books.html#44) and the Daisy Chain in the course of the story -
[Scenes and Characters](../books.html#3) had been written long before, but was taken up again in [Two Sides of the Shield ](../books.html#184)where also an early story [the Stokesley Secret ](../books.html#40)furnished some characters -
[Beechcroft At Rockstone](../books.html#210)
[Strolling Players](../books.html#229)
[The Long Vacation](../books.html#237)
make up the story
The others are all disconnected except
[The Chaplet of Pearls](../books.html#69)
[Stray Pearls](../books.html#170)
[The Release](../books.html#239) -
Some of the persons in [Magnum Bonum](../books.html#131) and Hopes and Fears are referred to again

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Envelope addressed to Mrs Wathen/ Withan House/ Alum Chine Road/ Bournemouth.

Postmarked 97.

[^2]: This was on the analogy of La Motte Fouqué\'s [Die Jahrzeiten](../others.html#102).
